notes:
POC objective: validate Redwood Dedicated for latency-sensitive dispatch chat + high-throughput embedding/reranking pipeline. Primary ask: guaranteed baseline throughput and latency SLOs under reserved GPU plan.

Summary of technical requirements (from discovery call):
- Workloads: real-time agent chat (avg prompt 80-150 tokens), reranking pipeline (short contexts, top-100 candidates), embeddings for route & document search (batch 10k vectors/day).
- Latency SLOs requested: p95 <= 120ms for chat generation (<=512 token context), p99 <= 250ms; reranking end-to-end per-request target <= 180ms at 200 qps; embedding batch throughput target 20k vectors/hr.
- Availability/throughput: baseline predictable throughput 200 qps for chat with burst up to 500 qps; sustained embed throughput 20k/hr.
- Cost sensitivity: wants < $0.08 per 1k chat tokens effective cost with dedicated pool and caching.
- Model preferences: prefer Llama-3-34B quantized and a Falcon-40B-instruct variant for reranking; fallbacks to 13B families for cost bursts. Expect Redwood to advise quantization profile.
- Routing & fallbacks: strict routing policy for mission-critical dispatch region (primary AZ), automatic fallback to smaller model variants on saturation.
- Security/compliance: VPC + customer-managed KMS (BYOK), SSO/SAML, audit_logging retention 12 months, data residency: US-only.

POC plan (agreed scope):
1) Bench baseline: microbench on single reserved worker to verify token/sec and kernel selection (Maya ran initial perf tests 2026-02-19).
2) Load test: ramp 0 -> 500 qps over 30 min, repeated 3x, measure p50/p95/p99, queue depth, GPU util, KV cache hit rate. Goal: p95 < 120ms at 200 qps sustained.
3) Soak test: 72-hour continuous at 200 qps for chat workload + periodic 10 minute spikes to 500 qps to validate autoscale/burst policy and memory stability.
4) Reranking run: synthetic workload of 10k requests with top-100 candidate scoring; target tail latency <= 180ms at 200 qps equivalent using batch async workers.
5) Embeddings throughput test: bulk ingest ~200k small docs in a controlled run to validate batching suggestions and cost metrics.
6) Failure mode tests: simulate node loss, model fallback, and network egress cap to confirm graceful degradation and fallback policies.

Metrics & success criteria to capture during POC:
- p50/p95/p99 latencies for generation, reranking, embeddings
- tokens/sec (aggregate) and tokens/GPU-second (efficiency)
- GPU utilization, memory pressure, kernel swap counts
- queue depth and request queuing time
- prefix/KV cache hit ratio and effect on tail latency
- cost projection (projected monthly spend for target SLA)
